teaser: Agents make execution cheap, so the people who know the problem can build first. The data favours experts, and Europe's sceptical money suits them.
core_idea: For twenty years the winning startup was often a clever outsider who found a pain point, raised on belief, hired the experts and displaced the incumbents, then became one; generative AI makes execution cheap enough that subject-matter experts can build the product themselves, which the data on founder age and industry experience always favoured; and Europe's investors, who want to see it working, value lower and fund later, suit a founder who can now build first, because money too early is one of the most reliable ways to kill a startup.
